lint.command: ruff check custom_components/ tests/ 2>/dev/null || ruff check .

validate-manifests.command: python3 -c "import json, glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('custom_components/*/manifest.json') + glob.glob('custom_components/*/translations/*.json')]; print('Manifests & translations valid')"

title.instructions: Concise English title (3-7 words) summarizing the workspace objective.

branchName.instructions: Use lowercase prefix feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/, or refactor/ followed by kebab-case slug (e.g. feat/add-sensor-support).
